name: Suzumoto Kiyoka
source:
The president of the academy and a diligent student with excellent grade. 
She is athletic and was once a member of the basketball team, before accepting the position of student-body president.
A girl of strong character who always does work. She believes in herself and never comes across as arrogant, and always tries to be a role models to other students.

However she has a secret. She has a constitution that made her whole body sexually sensitive.
This leads to her avoiding touching other people lest she get horny at the slightest thing.
As the president of the student council, she tries to help the protagonist, and treats him with lots of care.
